queries.requirement: Read GitHub issues, comment on them, and create pull requests.
queries.notes: The GitHub server directly covers all requested repository collaboration operations.

queries.requirement: List Slack channels, read message history, and send messages without deleting them.
queries.notes: Discord is lexically similar but cannot operate on Slack workspaces.

queries.requirement: Query PostgreSQL tables over TLS in read-only mode; inserts, updates, and deletes must not be available.
queries.notes: The admin server is clearly bad because it advertises every forbidden write operation; this exposes the lexical baseline's inability to enforce constraints.

queries.requirement: Search, create, and update Jira Cloud issues, but never delete an issue.
queries.notes: The labelled match is service-specific even though several candidates manage issues.

queries.requirement: List Amazon S3 buckets and download objects in eu-west-2 without deleting objects.
queries.notes: A local filesystem reader cannot access S3 even though both expose file-like reads.

queries.requirement: Read Stripe customers and create GBP invoices without issuing refunds.
queries.notes: Shopify is a commerce integration but does not manage Stripe invoices.

queries.requirement: List Kubernetes pods and read production namespace logs; never exec into or delete pods.
queries.notes: Container inspection is not a substitute for Kubernetes pod and namespace access.

queries.requirement: Search and read files in Google Drive, but do not share or delete them.
queries.notes: Notion contains pages rather than Google Drive files.

queries.requirement: Search and read Notion pages as a read-only knowledge source.
queries.notes: The service label disambiguates Notion from other document sources.

queries.requirement: Read GitLab merge requests and add review comments without merging them.
queries.notes: GitHub pull requests are not GitLab merge requests.

queries.requirement: Use OAuth to read and create Linear issues without deleting any issue.
queries.notes: Jira and GitHub have issue tools but do not operate on Linear.

queries.requirement: Read Sentry issues and releases outside the production environment without resolving issues.
queries.notes: Datadog is adjacent observability tooling but is not a Sentry issue source.

queries.requirement: Query Datadog metrics over the last 24 hours and create monitors without deleting them.
queries.notes: Sentry cannot query Datadog metrics or create Datadog monitors.

queries.requirement: Send at most 100 SMS messages per day with Twilio; voice calls must not be supported.
queries.notes: The general Twilio server advertises the explicitly forbidden voice capability.

queries.requirement: List and read local Markdown files under /docs without writing or deleting files.
queries.notes: Cloud document stores cannot access a local /docs path.

queries.requirement: Navigate web pages and take screenshots without submitting forms or downloading files.
queries.notes: A raw HTTP client cannot render pages or take browser screenshots.

queries.requirement: Run read-only SQLite queries on a local database without schema or row writes.
queries.notes: PostgreSQL tools cannot query a SQLite database.

queries.requirement: Read and send Gmail messages with attachments, but never delete email.
queries.notes: Slack messages are not email and cannot operate on Gmail mailboxes.

queries.requirement: Sync Salesforce opportunities and contacts into a CRM dashboard.
queries.notes: The candidate set contains no Salesforce integration; the ranker should return no positive lexical match.

queries.requirement: Transcribe podcast audio with speaker diarization and timestamped captions.
queries.notes: None of the candidates offers speech-to-text or diarization.
